contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

The object is a rim sherd of a mortaria. The fabric and situation grits suggests it is Mancetter mortarium which dates to the 1st to early 4th centuries. On the upper face of the rim there are letters which have probably been stamped.
